status: Requirement-level frozen plan; executable acceptance tests not yet implemented
execution_rule: At each stage, run baseline and all earlier introduced cases against their original stage snapshots, plus newly introduced cases. Do not count regressions as new tasks. No aggregation into statistical sample sizes.

case_families.mutation_or_requirement: Unmodified matching-version snapshots; validate all seven normalized streams, 14 endpoint descriptors, provenance and Q1/Q2/Q3 results
Reverse provider, port, type, equipment and mapping declaration lists; output unchanged
Append identical boundary and field-mapping assertions; output unchanged
Compare recursive input snapshots before and after integrate and all queries; no mutations
Remove the condensate boundary mapping
Assign hot_reheat the producer endpoint of hp_steam
Change provider A temperature native unit and corresponding field mapping unit to kg/s
On v1 only, change provider A pressure field-mapping declared_unit from bar to MPa, leaving native unit bar unchanged
Remove the gt_exhaust producer payload
Add a payload field not in its native field_set
Set gt_exhaust producer temperature to true
Set gt_exhaust producer pressure to NaN as in-memory float
Set gt_exhaust producer pressure to negative one in declared native units
Replace gt_exhaust producer composition with {N2:0.5}
Add 10 to hp_steam consumer temperature without changing producer
Change requested_versions.A to 99.0
Set provider A root ThermalAsset parent_type_id to HRSG
Remove every provider_type_mappings entry whose provider is A
Use valid v2 native schemas, mappings, fields and payload versions; same canonical physical results and all query sets
Verify ControlledHRSG and ReheatSteamTurbine leaf ancestry includes mapped ancestors and correct Q2 sets; no manual leaf list supplied
Rename one v2 producer payload scalar field to its v1 alias without changing v2 declarations
Use v2 metadata/requested versions with one payload schema_version 1.0
Use v3 schemas with identical inlet local labels in different namespaces; expose all 14 correct endpoints and both return identities
Replace mapping with providers/variant_v3_conflicting_boundary_mapping.json
Replace provider A with providers/variant_v3_missing_parent_provider_a.json
Replace mapping with providers/variant_v3_unqualified_boundary_mapping.json

conversion_rule: Independent single-quantity unit tests outside plant payload comparisons; executable adapter must expose its quantity normalization operation for these checks. Same function signature normalize_quantity(quantity,value,unit) for both arms. Correct value and rejection rules identical to API. No test count claimed until executable suite frozen.
